missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Батарея' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'разрядилась'. 'Эта' agrees in the feminine, and 'совсем' intensifies the verb.

missions.phrase: Я купил новую батарею для телефона.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Батарею' is the accusative direct object of 'купил'. The feminine -я ending shifts to -ю in the accusative singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Батареи' is genitive in the 'у' frame, telling us whose charge it is. The feminine genitive singular ending is -и after the soft stem.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a preposition. 'Без батареи' uses the genitive form 'батареи' after 'без' to express lack. The feminine genitive ending is -и.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В батарее' uses the prepositional form 'батарее' after 'в' to show where the energy ran out. The feminine ending becomes -е.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Батареей' is in the instrumental case, the thing used to replace the part. The feminine instrumental ending is -ей after the soft stem.
Strategic focus: Dative after a preposition. 'К батарее' uses the dative form 'батарее' after 'к' to express connection toward it. The feminine dative ending is -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Батареи' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'продаются'. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantity word. 'Батарей' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. The feminine plural keeps the soft -й ending.
Strategic focus: Accusative request. 'Батарею' is the accusative object of the imperative 'дай'. 'Эту' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'мне' marks the recipient in the dative.
